name: SS Carnatic

sources.title: SS Carnatic — P&O steamer of 1862 (iron frames, wooden planking, compound engine and sails), lost on Sha'ab Abu Nuhas in September 1869; broke in two, the halves settled almost back together
The SS Thistlegorm site — other wrecks: the Carnatic
Yachtway — SS Carnatic: 18-27 m, exposed ribs, wine bottles in the debris

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q1043906_carnatic.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. On her port side, broken in two with the halves almost together; the wooden decks gone, the iron deck beams and frames open like a ribcage, a few planks left; the deckhouse crumpled, funnel and masts gone (the masts lying on the sand); wine and soda-water bottles about the stern. The real wreck lies in 18-27 m; on Offlined's flat seabed she lies at the mean depth. Heading (not published: 0), the place of the break and the rig are approximate. model_built.glb: the steamer as she sailed in 1869. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
